_description: Reproducible behaviour worth a future debugger's time: symptoms seen, root cause found, fix applied. Includes recurring footguns (the footgun IS the symptom). Append only; prefer a new entry over editing when understanding evolves.

title: Repo root listing empty, GitHub returns 404
root_cause: vue-router 5 leaves the catch-all path param undefined at the repo root; the proxy interpolated it into the GitHub URL.
fix: Default the missing path to an empty string in the proxy handler.

title: Dropdown menu stays open after selecting an item
symptoms: FileCard menu remains open after Download/Replace
root_cause: In Nuxt UI 4, calling preventDefault inside an item onSelect keeps the menu open; the menu is portaled, so stopPropagation is no longer needed to avoid triggering the card link.

title: Borders render in text color instead of gray
symptoms: Card/input borders look dark after the Tailwind 4 upgrade
root_cause: Tailwind 4 defaults border-color to currentColor (v3 used gray-200).
fix: Base-layer rule restoring the gray default border color.

title: Non-ASCII text garbled in file previews
symptoms: Accented characters render as mojibake (venerdì -> venerdÃ¬) in Code/Text previews
root_cause: atob returns a Latin-1 binary string, so multi-byte UTF-8 in GitHub base64 content is decoded byte by byte.
fix: Decode bytes through TextDecoder via the shared decodeBase64Utf8 helper.
